outputs.discrepancies: The caption text describes panel E as a bipartite split-GFP assay involving 'a PacL1-GFP11 fusion protein together with GFP1-10 (control) or the indicated proteins fused to GFP11... or GFP1-10...'. However, the panel image's x-axis labels ('Control', 'PacL2/CtpGMBD', 'PacL2Δ55-84/CtpGMBD') indicate the assay involves PacL2 and CtpG constructs, not PacL1. This is also consistent with the statistical reference note for panel E ('PacL2/CtpGMBD'), suggesting the general description sentence mentioning 'PacL1-GFP11' is inconsistent with the actual content shown.
